extracted.intended_audience: Rospatent/FIPS staff, patent examiners, patent information users (applicants, businesses, libraries, TISCs), and partner patent offices
extracted.subtask_description: Standards, requirements and operational criteria for national patent information systems, digital registries, examination databases, and the State Patent Collection (SPC) used by Rospatent/FIPS and external users. Covers automation, data quality, access, publication and preservation practices for patent-related information services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of automated systems and electronic services
rubrics_metrics.description: Further work on optimization of Office workflows and the development of electronic services to reduce time for provision of state services on state registration of IPR objects and to increase the share of citizens using digital public services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes automation of technological processes in digital document management for examination (inventions and utility models), automatic generation of search reports in ST.96 format, switching to structured publication of information, full support for examination and interaction with applicants on electronic applications, and implementation of provisions of Government Decree No.1151 (recognition of applications as withdrawn).

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic generation of search reports (ST.96) and structured publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Switch to automatic generation of search reports in the ST.96 format to enable publication of relevant information in a structured form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of automation of technological processes for examination of inventions and utility models; supports downstream structured publication and data reuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic verification of goods and services lists in trademark examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Automatic verification of goods and services lists during trademark examination within the digital workflow to increase experts' efficiency and accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improves automatic terminology checking and provides visual representations of verification results; implemented in the system for digital workflow with trademark applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improvement of personal accounts for electronic services and user support
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhance functional range of Personal Accounts for electronic services and information user support, including answers via technical support and updates to 'Filing application' guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes tutorial videos (increased views), regular meetings on digital services, and contributed to achieving 81% of national applications filed electronically in 2019.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic registration and uploading of incoming correspondence with electronic signature
rubrics_metrics.description: Transition to automatic registration and uploading of incoming correspondence with electronic signature from Personal Accounts to filing systems for various application types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduces labor costs for registration/processing of secondary correspondence, shortens delivery time to expert divisions, and eliminates manual registration errors by operators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expansion of filing services via Technology and Innovation Support Centers (TISCs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand list of services provided to TISCs for filing applications for industrial property and means of individualization, including utility models and appellations of origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables broader access points for applicants to file specific IP application types through regional support centers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimization of paper-to-digital processing and document quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Optimize processing of paper documents for digitization and improve electronic document quality for internal systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes upgrades to user control (login/logout, two-factor identification), development of new bibliographic data schemas, and optimization of reporting and monitoring subsystems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation of automated workflow for Hague international industrial design registrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement automated workflow system for international registrations of industrial designs under the Hague agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides end-to-end electronic handling for Hague-system design filings within the national systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance and completeness of electronic registers
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain electronic registers (ESR of TM, ESR of IN, ESR of UM, ESR of ID, ER of CP, ER of DB, ER of ICT, List of WTM, etc.) and report counts and coverage as of reporting dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registers must be kept current; report lists and numeric holdings (examples given for Dec 31, 2019) and support publication and user access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PatSearch as primary examiner information retrieval system
rubrics_metrics.description: Use PatSearch professional search system for examiners conducting searches during examination of inventions and utility models; system implements extended functions taking into account importance of patent search across science and technical fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PatSearch contains >200 million patent documents, arrays from many national and international offices; enhancements include amino acid/nucleotide search via EMBL, LexisNexis patent upload for English-language world patent collection, and integration of AI-based search results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Granting secured external access to internal search systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide secured-channel access to internal search systems (PatSearch) to partner patent offices and organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019 access was granted to Republic of Kazakhstan, Moldova, Kyrgyz Republic, Eurasian Patent Office, and State Corporation Rosatom; promotes cooperation and shared search capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development and updating of Rospatent and FIPS websites and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide and update website sections to support state services, legal information, training, project materials, conferences, guides, glossaries and user surveys.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of new/updated sections listed; sites host tutorials, methodology, analytics pages, and collect user satisfaction surveys; increased published materials (new documents +115%, modified +92%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Account service feature set for filing and case management
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Account must provide registration, filing of multiple application types (industrial design, computer program, database), filing of Hague international designs, access to previous drafts and history (for new Personal Account version), automatic registration of correspondence, and electronic appeals to Patent Disputes Chamber.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also supports filing via ARM Registrar using a qualified electronic signature; these features facilitate full digital interaction between applicants and FIPS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive Internet search resources and database coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide and maintain a set of internet-accessible databases: published applications, full-text patents, abstracts (RU and EN), perspective inventions, retrospective facsimile databases, utility models, industrial designs, trademarks, appellations of origin, well-known marks list, computer programs, registered databases, integrated circuit topographies, IPC, ICGS, ICID.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each database's content, date coverage, and record counts are specified; public availability varies by database and object type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of database access to institutions and public users
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant access to internal full-text databases and other resources to regional institutions, state projects participants, TISCs, federal services and agencies, courts, and other designated organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists numbers of institutions and categories granted access in 2019; third-party public availability described for specific databases and bulletins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Registries: free public access and search functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide free access to all documents in 'Open Registries' and implement search and viewing conveniences in 'Official Publications' (search by document number, IP type, document type, class, filing date) and RSS subscriptions for selective dissemination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track and report page views and usage metrics for Open Registries; real-time recording of legally important actions into the electronic State Register supports continuous publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuance and format of official bulletins and publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue issuing official electronic bulletins (Inventions. Utility models; Trademarks, Service marks and Appellations of Origin; Industrial Designs; Computer programs, Databases, ICT) and provide publications in formats compliant with bulletin-on-disk; supply via FTP and other electronic channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain continuous publication flow; support subscribers and distributors with electronic delivery for faster receipt and simpler processing; record user requests statistics for bulletins.

rubrics_metrics.name: FIPS information products for subscribers and library collections
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce and distribute information products (electronic and printed), retrospective DVD sets, quarterly IRA on DVD, and other materials to support local patent collections and patent information research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide annual sets (since 1924 for inventions), retrospective sets, and options for FTP delivery; supply to organizations establishing local patent collections and to TISCs.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Patent Collection (SPC) completeness and quality requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain and develop the SPC ensuring completeness and quality of the State Patent Fund, as well as reliable access for a wide range of users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As of Dec 31, 2019 SPC contained 142.1 million copies; tasks identified include introduction of VPTB automated library system (Irbis64) and improvement of patent information support for Rospatent system employees and external users.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPC composition, carriers and electronic availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide SPC on tangible carriers (optical disks, paper, microcarriers) and electronically (PatSearch); increase electronic share of SPC holdings and provide access via PatSearch, National Electronic Library (NEL), eLibrary.ru, and Yandex.Patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By end of 2019, 67% of SPC was electronic; provide access channels for diverse user needs while controlling access to national applications where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation and library automation measures for SPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement automated library systems (Irbis64), barcode and RFID automation, and carry out preservation actions (mass neutralization of paper acidity) to ensure long-term preservation of SPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Processed large retrospective arrays (about 7 tons) and uploaded millions of documents; automation expands search/service capabilities and integration with FIPS website.

rubrics_metrics.name: International exchange and ingestion of foreign patent documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Carry out international exchange with foreign patent offices primarily by FTP/network uploads; ingest large volumes of foreign patent documentation to fill SPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019, 6.0 million documents were uploaded via international exchange; exchange obligations include providing official publications to foreign patent offices via FTP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access control and restrictions in internal search systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Define and enforce access levels in PatSearch and other systems (e.g., some restrictions for national applications) and provide remote database access via contracts with resource owners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PatSearch functionality is primarily intended for examiners; computer-class Library access provided to all user categories with restrictions on national application materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring, reporting and statistics for information services
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuously monitor completeness of SPC, record incoming/uploaded documentation, track quantitative characteristics of the SPC and internet/database usage (queries, page views, distributions by object type), and publish statistical data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report yearly metrics (queries, registry views, bulletin requests, database hits) and provide charts/tables on distributions and trends to evaluate service performance and user needs.
